title: The 10 Best Band Saws
subtitle: 9-inch benchtop to 14-inch floor band saws for curves, resawing and small-shop woodworking, ranked from live Amazon data.
intro: A band saw cuts curves, rips small stock and resaws boards into thinner ones, with a narrow kerf that wastes little wood. We ranked 10 best-sellers on rating, review volume and features (two speeds, a resaw height of 4.5 inches or more, ball-bearing blade guides and a fence in the box). Wheel size sets the class: 9- and 10-inch benchtop saws handle curves and small parts; 14-inch floor saws resaw boards 8 to 13 inches tall. They run from about $139 for WEN's 9-inch to $1,549 for JET's 14-inch.

changelog.note: Page published with 10 ranked picks and 1 tool to avoid.

products.name: SKIL 2.8 Amp 9 In. 2-Speed Benchtop Band Saw for Woodworking (BW9501-00)
products.verdict: A well-equipped 9-inch: an induction motor, two speeds with tool-free belt tensioning, quick blade tension, ball-bearing guides top and bottom, and rack-and-pinion table tilt.
products.best_for: A benchtop saw that's easy to set up and keep in tune.
products.skip_if: You need to resaw wide boards; a 9-inch saw is for curves and small parts.

products.name: WEN 9-Inch Band Saw, 2.8-Amp Benchtop (BA3959)
products.verdict: The best-selling and most-reviewed band saw here: a 9-inch with 3-1/2 inches of cut depth, a rip fence, a miter gauge, a 2-1/2-inch dust port and an adjustable blade guard, for about $139.
products.best_for: A first band saw for curves and crafts.
products.skip_if: You want two speeds for plastics and metal.
pros: Rip fence and miter gauge included

products.name: WOODSKIL 9-Inch Band Saw, 3-Amp Benchtop Bandsaw, 2500 FPM
products.verdict: A 1/2 HP 9-inch with a cast aluminum table, a 120° miter gauge, a steel base, a 2-1/2-inch dust port and a wheel brush.
products.best_for: A sturdy 9-inch with a miter gauge.
products.skip_if: The WEN BA3959 does the same for about $84 less.

products.name: QD-KYOHO Portable 9-Inch Bandsaw for Woodworking, 2526 FPM, 1/3 HP, 2.5-Amp
products.verdict: A portable 9-inch with a top carry handle, a 2 mm powder-coated steel frame, quick-release blade tension and tool-free guide adjustment.
products.best_for: Moving a band saw between bench and storage.
products.skip_if: Note the 97 reviews are shared across QD-KYOHO's band saw listings.

products.name: SHOPMAX 4.2 Amp 10-inch Benchtop Band Saw
products.verdict: A 10-inch with a 4.2A induction motor, 4-1/2 inches of cut depth and steel construction, for less than the 9-inch SKIL.
products.best_for: More resaw height on a benchtop budget.
products.skip_if: You want a track record; it has 43 reviews.

products.name: WOODSKIL 10-Inch Benchtop Bandsaw with Stand, 3.4A Dual-Speed
products.verdict: A 10-inch on a stand with two speeds, six ball-bearing guides that stop drift, a quick tension lever and tool-free doors, with a 2-year warranty.
products.best_for: A stand-mounted 10-inch with good blade guidance.
products.skip_if: Reviews are shared with WOODSKIL's 9-inch listing.

products.name: QD-KYOHO 10-Inch Bandsaw, 1515 & 3280 FPM Dual-Speed, 1/2 HP, 5.3-Amp, Double-Sided Fence
products.verdict: A 10-inch with a big 20.5 x 17.5-inch table, a low speed for metal and a high speed for wood, 4-3/4 inches of depth and a fence usable from either side.
products.best_for: Wood and light metal in a mid-size saw.
products.skip_if: Reviews are shared across QD-KYOHO's models.
pros: Two speeds for wood and metal

products.name: JET 10-Inch Woodworking Band Saw with Stand, 1/2 HP (JWB-10)
products.verdict: JET's 10-inch benchtop that moves to the floor on its steel stand, with a Poly-V drive that cuts vibration and ball-bearing guides above and below.
products.best_for: A compact JET for small shops.
products.skip_if: Value matters; at 4.0 stars it trails cheaper saws.

products.name: WEN BA1487 Band Saw with Stand, Two-Speed, 14-Inch
products.verdict: A 14-inch floor saw with an 8.85-inch resaw, two speeds, blades up to 1 inch wide, a tension gauge, a circle-cutting guide, a work light and a 3-in-1 dust port.
products.best_for: Resawing on a budget for a 14-inch.
products.skip_if: You need 13-inch resaw; the JET has it.

products.name: JET 14" Woodworking Band Saw, 1.75 HP, 13" Deep-Cut Resaw Capacity
products.verdict: A serious resaw saw: 13 inches of resaw height from a 1.75 HP motor, a ground cast iron table, blades from 1/8 to 3/4 inch, a machined resaw fence, and a 5-year warranty.
products.best_for: Resawing veneer and wide boards in a home or small production shop.
products.skip_if: You cut curves and small parts; a benchtop saw does that for a tenth of the price.

avoid.name: DeWalt 9" Band Saw, 3.5 AMP Motor, Two-Speed (1700 & 2500 SPM), LED Worklight
avoid.flag: Blade speed given in strokes per minute; lowest rating
avoid.verdict: A 9-inch band saw whose listing rates it in a unit band saws don't use. For $30 less, the SKIL BW9501 is a 2-speed 9-inch with a clear spec sheet.
reasons: It quotes blade speed as '1700 & 2500 SPM' (strokes per minute), the unit for reciprocating and scroll saws. A band saw's continuous blade is rated in feet per minute.
At 3.8 stars it's the lowest-rated band saw we compared.
The spec table says it needs 'Nonstandard Battery batteries' for a corded saw, so the listing's details can't be trusted.

buyers_guide.q: What size band saw do I need?
buyers_guide.a: 9- and 10-inch benchtop saws cut curves, small parts and stock up to about 3-1/2 to 4-3/4 inches thick. 14-inch floor saws resaw boards 8 to 13 inches tall and run wider blades for straight rips.
Resawing slices a board on edge into thinner boards or veneer. It needs a tall cut depth, a strong motor, a wide blade and a tall fence, which is why it's a 14-inch saw's job.
High speed for wood; low speed for plastics, aluminum and other non-ferrous metals, which melt or dull blades at wood speeds.
Narrow blades (1/8-1/4 inch) cut tight curves; wide blades (1/2 inch and up) cut straighter and resaw. Fewer teeth per inch cut faster; more teeth cut smoother.
Yes. Bearing guides above and below the table keep the blade from drifting and twisting, which gives straighter cuts and longer blade life.
